map.空气阻力 F 与车速的平方成正比，而克服风阻所需的功率 P=F·v 与车速的立方: Aero drag F is proportional to the square of speed, while the power needed to overcome it P=F·v is proportional to the cube. Doubling speed therefore multiplies drag power about eightfold, which is the root cause of the steep energy rise at highway speeds.

map.为什么高速油耗涨得明显？: Why does fuel consumption rise so sharply at high speed?

SUVs and boxy shapes have higher Cd, making the high-speed penalty worse; this is why EVs drain and engines burn more fuel on the highway.
map.迎风面积怎么估？: How do I estimate frontal area?
map.迎风面积≈车宽×车高×修正系数（流线造型约 0.75–0.85）。可直接查厂家风: Frontal area ≈ width × height × a correction factor (about 0.75–0.85 for streamlined bodies). Look up manufacturer wind-tunnel data or approximate from the outline projection. Together with Cd it sets drag, so low-drag design needs both small area and low Cd.
